activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
Changing into work scrubs and packing work bag and ID badge
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working as a health care professional: patient rounds, medication administration and clinical documentation
Taking a lunch break in the staff room
Continuing clinical duties: patient assessments, handover notes and coordinating with the care team
Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and microwave
Checking the severe storm warning, charging the phone and computer and preparing for a possible power outage
Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
Winding down under the fan, reading on the phone and setting an alarm
